title: Call Neighbours Yourself: Graph Walks with Destination-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning over text-attributed graphs (TAGs) requires large language models (LLMs) to combine a node's text with evidence distributed across its neighbourhood. Existing methods fix the set of accessible neighbours before generation, forcing reasoning to operate over a static context and preventing the model from acquiring missing evidence during inference. We argue that neighbour selection should itself be part of the reasoning process. To this end, we propose Call Neighbours Yourself (CNY), a framework that enables LLMs to proactively explore graph neighbourhoods through topology-constrained graph-walk actions. Instead of reasoning over a pre-selected neighbour set, CNY exposes lightweight neighbour previews and learns when to expand candidate neighbours for additional evidence. translated_title: 自行呼叫邻居：基于目标条件在线策略自蒸馏的图游走
translated_abstract: 对文本属性图（TAG）进行推理需要大语言模型（LLM）将节点的文本与分布在其邻域中的证据相结合。现有方法在生成之前就固定了可访问邻居的集合，迫使推理只能在静态上下文中进行，并使模型无法在推理过程中获取缺失的证据。我们认为，邻居选择本身应当成为推理过程的一部分。为此，我们提出了“自行呼叫邻居”（CNY）框架，使大语言模型能够通过拓扑约束的图游走动作主动探索图邻域。CNY 不再在预先选定的邻居集合上进行推理，而是提供轻量级的邻居预览，并学习何时扩展候选邻居以获取额外证据。为了解决邻居探索中的延迟信用分配难题，我们引入了目标条件化的在线策略自蒸馏方法，该方法回顾性地评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 CNY 框架，让大语言模型在文本属性图推理中通过拓扑约束的图游走动作自主探索和扩展邻居，并以目标条件化的在线策略自蒸馏解决邻居探索的延迟奖励难题。
en_tdlr: CNY enables LLMs to proactively explore graph neighbourhoods via topology-constrained graph-walk actions during reasoning, and introduces destination-conditioned on-policy self-distillation to address the delayed-credit challenge of neighbour exploration.
